t: The Furniture Exchange be and is hereby granted permission, revocable at will of the Board of Supervisors, to maintain and operate an automobile supply station on the northeast corner of New Montgomery and Howard streets.
pl: Furniture Exchange gets a filling station at New Montgomery and Howard

t: Cosmos place, from Taylor street to a line 60 feet westerly (except the sidewalk space on the northerly side of Cosmos place), be temporarily closed for a period of forty-five days from date of approval of this resolution…
